content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients have rheumatoid arthritis on record?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT 
    c.concept_id, 
    c.concept_name, 
    c.vocabulary_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE UPPER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS%'
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id
ORDER BY patient_count DESC;
